rationale: The EASA NPA 2025-07(B) document, as inspected, explicitly proposes a detailed framework for AI trustworthiness. The provided excerpts and inspection scope confirm that it spans operational domain (DS.AI.150, GM1 AI.150), risk assessment (DS.AI.160, AMC1 AI.160(a)), system development assurance (DS.AI.150, AMC1 AI.150), supervised-ML learning assurance (AMC2 AI.150), configuration/life-cycle data (AMC1 AI.150(d), AMC2 AI.150(b)(1)), and in-service monitoring (DS.AI.160, AMC1 AI.160(a)). The source's status as a 'Notice of Proposed Amendment' and 'Proposed DS.AI' aligns with the claim's scope and status as 'proposed material, not final AMC/GM or an approved application' and 'provisional'. Project artifacts further confirm its use as a 'substantial candidate lifecycle against which the project must compare its own evidence contracts'.
